rotation_note: Unattended-run override: NO rotating subset. All 3 core keywords plus the entire politics pool (34 keywords, grouped into policy_regulation / elections_public_opinion / geopolitics) are working keywords today (37 total). Day-of-year 331 sets ORDER only: group lead rotates so no group leads twice in a row (policy_regulation led 11-25, elections_public_opinion led 11-26, so geopolitics leads today, then policy_regulation, then elections_public_opinion); within each group the list starts at offset 331 % group_size in pool order (geopolitics 331 % 10 = 1: US China AI competition first; policy 331 % 15 = 1: AI executive order first; elections 331 % 9 = 7: 딥페이크 선거 first). Window: last brief was 2026-11-26, so items published 11-26 (after the prior harvest) through 11-27 are in scope. Context: Friday 11-27. US is the day after Thanksgiving: federal offices are nominally open but thin; the Federal Register still publishes 11-27 and the public-inspection list for 11-30 posts today; courts mostly quiet, so expect few US court orders. Thursday 11-26 US releases were near zero (holiday). Lean on Korea, EU/UK, Taiwan, Japan, China, Canada, India, Australia. Korea: 국회 정기회 막바지, 예산안 법정 처리기한 12-2 — 예결위 소위 증감액, 과방위·법사위 법안소위 의결, 본회의 일정; 금요일 부처 보도자료(과기정통부·개인정보위·방미통위·방미심위·선관위·문체부·산업부·행안부). EU: Friday Council/Coreper outputs on the digital omnibus / AI Act delay; Commission AI Office guidance; EuroHPC. UK: DSIT/AISI/ICO/Ofcom. Taiwan 9-in-1 local elections are Saturday 11-28: in the last 48 hours, NEW official actions (CEC/MJIB/MODA/NSB/prosecutors) on AI deepfakes or AI-driven influence ops — new indictments, takedown orders, official counts, platform takedown reports — are high-value; previously covered items (Vanderbilt/Doublethink AI personas study 11-26, Puma Shen indictment 11-22, ~2,700 Threads accounts 11-21, CIB 219 cases 11-13) do not qualify, and results/turnout are OUT of scope (Saturday is after today's window anyway). Japan: AI-power goal in security documents covered 11-26 — only the cabinet decision on the revised documents is new. Hooks — only official documents/actions are new, skip previews and reactions: Character.AI bankruptcy auction Dec 1 (only a court ruling on sale terms or the outcome); Nvidia California AG subpoena (Huang testimony Dec 1 — skip previews); EU AI gigafactories (deadline moved to 12-30, covered 11-26); FCC SpaceX Starmind orbital AI data centers (covered 11-26). In scope: bills introduced/marked up, agency rules/bulletins, court rulings and filings, regulator enforcement, export-control actions, official after-action reports on AI-enabled interference, platform takedown reports. OUT of scope: who won, seat counts, polling, horse-race analysis, commentary without a new document. Neutrality rule from sources.json applies: report decisions/filings/releases, attribute contested claims, no partisan framing.
